subject: Correcting for Overdispersion of SMR Error

messages.author: 7785776adcf8ff2d
messages.subject: Correcting for Overdispersion of SMR Error
parts:
Hello,
I'm working through analysis of our partially marked deer population data using the spatial mark-resight tools in secr. Going through the initial analysis went well once correcting the input files for some typos. 

I am now trying to check for overdispersion as it has a decent probability of being present based on the behavior and pattern of detection of marked deer within the population. I tried to fit the code within documentation for 4.5.3 to address overdispersion and am getting the error.

Error in secr.design.MS(capthist, model, timecov, sessioncov, groups,  :
  ts is used only for mark-resight data

The code I've been using is down below. The null model fit has worked perfectly, with a result perfectly in line with expectation, so I'm not sure why the second fit has the warning of only use for mark-resight data, when that is what it is.

Thanks,

Martin

CH2 <- read.capthist("fdcapt.txt", "2020surveyNU.txt", detector = "count", verify = FALSE, markocc = rep(0,62))

CH2 <-addSightings(CH2,"Tu2.txt","Tm2.txt")

mask <- make.mask(traps(CH2), nx = 32, buffer = 50)

fit0 <- secr.fit(CH2, mask = mask, trace = FALSE, details = list(knownmarks = FALSE))
fit0 <- secr.fit(CH2, mask = mask, trace = FALSE, start = fit0,
                 details = list(nsim = 10000, knownmarks = FALSE))
predict(fit0, newdata = data.frame(ts = factor(c("M","S"))))

fit1 <- secr.fit(CH2, model = list(g0~ts), mask = mask, trace = FALSE,
                 start = fit0, details = list(nsim = 10000, knownmarks = FALSE))

### Error happens here

predict(fit1, newdata = data.frame(ts = factor(c("M","S"))))

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Correcting for Overdispersion of SMR Error
parts:
There are no marking occasions in CH2, so it doesn't make sense to contrast marking and sighting occasions. I expect you figured this out.
Murray
